# denguedatasets

`denguedatasets` is an R package that provides a curated collection of
open-access dengue fever surveillance and climate datasets for
epidemiological research and machine learning. It includes surveillance
records, climatic covariates, and mortality indicators from Bangladesh,
the Philippines, Taiwan, Sri Lanka, Brazil, Colombia, Pakistan, India,
Peru, Indonesia, and Sierra Leone, covering case counts, deaths,
case-fatality rates, and associated meteorological variables
(temperature, humidity, precipitation) suitable for spatiotemporal
analysis, outbreak prediction, machine learning, and time-series
modeling. Original sources come from Kaggle.

## Philosophy

The authors’ vision is to create data packages, functions, or a
combination of both in **Julia**, **R**, and **Python**, contributing to
the interoperability of algorithms and data to transform the information
into decisions that help solve specific problems.

In the case of data packages, the authors’ vision is to create
specialized packages focused on specific topics and subtopics. Instead
of searching through multiple diverse and heterogeneous sources, users
can access all these interesting datasets in a single package.

Specifically, in the case of the denguedasets package, each included
dataset is specialized in dengue fever, providing a valuable source of
information for academics, data scientists, statisticians, modelers,
university professors, or students interested in working with this
combination of topics.

## Installation

You can install the development version of denguedatasets from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("fdzul/denguedatasets")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(denguedatasets)
## basic example code
```

``` r

data("dengue_peru", package = "denguedatasets")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`dengue_bangladesh`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_bangladesh.md)
  : Dengue Dataset of Bangladesh: Unraveling Dengue
- [`dengue_bangladesh_mortality`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_bangladesh_mortality.md)
  : Climatic Influence on Dengue Mortality
- [`dengue_brazil`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_brazil.md)
  : Brazil Dengue Dataset 2000-2019
- [`dengue_brazil_labels`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_brazil_labels.md)
  : Brazil Dengue Dataset 2000-2019 labels
- [`dengue_colombia`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_colombia.md)
  : Dengue Tabular Data and Satellite Images
- [`dengue_colombia_medellin`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_colombia_medellin.md)
  : Dengue Tabular Data and Satellite Images
- [`dengue_india`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_india.md)
  : Dengue cases and deaths in India
- [`dengue_jakarta`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_jakarta.md)
  : Jakarta Dengue Cases and Weather Data from 2021 to 2024.
- [`dengue_pakistan`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_pakistan.md)
  : Dengue surveillance data of Pakistan.
- [`dengue_peru`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_peru.md)
  : Dengue data in Peru from 2019 to 2022.
- [`dengue_philippines`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_philippines.md)
  : Philippines Dengue Cases from 2016 to 2020
- [`dengue_sierra_leone`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_sierra_leone.md)
  : The Sierra Leone Freetown DengueAI Dataset from 2015 to 2024
- [`dengue_sri_lanka_2019`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_sri_lanka_2019.md)
  : Sri Lanka Dengue Data of 2019
- [`dengue_sri_lanka_2020`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_sri_lanka_2020.md)
  : Sri Lanka Dengue Data of 2020
- [`dengue_sri_lanka_2021`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_sri_lanka_2021.md)
  : Sri Lanka Dengue Data of 2021
- [`dengue_taiwan`](https://fdzul.github.io/denguedatasets/reference/dengue_taiwan.md)
  : Taiwan Dengue Cases from 1998 to 2024
